name: Attachment
description: A chip or card for a file attached to a message or a prompt: its name, size, a type icon, an upload progress bar or error, and an optional remove button. A preview variant shows a thumbnail for pictures. AttachmentList groups several as a list.

name.description: The file name. It is the accessible name of the chip and of its remove button.

sizeText.description: The size as text, e.g. "2.4 MB". Format it yourself so the language and units match the rest of the page.

mediaType.description: The media type, e.g. "application/pdf". It only picks the icon.

variant.description: chip is a compact row with an icon. preview is a card with a thumbnail above the name.

status.description: ready is a normal file. uploading shows a progress bar. error shows the error message.

progress.description: Upload progress from 0 to 100. Leave it out while uploading for an indeterminate bar.

errorMessage.description: What went wrong, shown when status is error.

thumbnail.description: The picture for the preview variant, usually an img with alt text. Without it the type icon is shown.

href.description: Makes the name a link that opens the file.

onPress.description: Makes the name a button that opens or previews the file. Use href or onPress, not both.

onRemove.description: Shows a remove button. Called when it is pressed.

a11y.role: listitem when inside AttachmentList, otherwise a plain group
keyboard: Tab: moves to the name when it is a link or button, then to the remove button
Enter: opens the file from the name
Enter or Space: removes the file from the remove button
requirements: The remove button is named "Remove <file name>" so several of them are told apart
Uploading shows a progressbar named "Uploading <file name>" with its value; without progress it is indeterminate
An error is shown as text with an icon, announced as an alert, and never by color alone
The type icon is decorative; the name and size are real text
A thumbnail has its own alt text; the card does not repeat it
The progress bar stands still for reduced motion

use_when: Showing files attached to a prompt before it is sent
Showing files inside a sent message
Showing upload progress and failures for each file
avoid_when: Choosing files or dropping them: use FileUpload
A table of documents with many columns: use a table
anti_patterns: A remove button for a file in an already sent message
Showing an uploading state with no way to see it fail: always handle the error status
A thumbnail with no alt text
